findings.message: The host_adapter response outputs are declared and driven from memory response storage, but the structural graph has no connections from host_adapter.rsp_valid and host_adapter.rsp_rdata to top.rsp_valid and top.rsp_rdata. The recorded architecture validation also identifies those top sinks as undriven and the adapter outputs as unused. Consequently, committed READ responses cannot reach the required host-visible response ports, and response-delivery bindings at the top cannot distinguish the claimed behavior. Add the missing structural top-level response connections and rerun architecture validation.

The selected DDR4-3200 timing values are present, but their authoritative provenance and acceptance remain explicitly marked requires_review and the package retains an open question blocking design review. Compiler checks and planned timing-boundary verification can confirm implementation against the supplied values but cannot establish that the external timing-library source is authoritative. Obtain and record the required external profile-source review or disposition before RTL generation; do not treat the populated numeric library as evidence that this assumption is resolved.
